title: Discovery - CartJet AI Shopping Assistant
summary: Early-stage discovery for an AI shopping assistant. Discussion focused on token costs and streaming latency; no data residency requirements mentioned.
transcript:
Meeting: Discovery - CartJet AI Shopping Assistant
Date: 2025-02-13
Duration: 29 min

[00:00] Jordan (Redwood): Hey Alina, Sam. What are you building?
[00:08] Alina (CartJet): Shopping assistant that chats and then calls tools to build carts.

[01:20] Sam (CartJet): Were super cost sensitive. We need streaming and low time to first token.
[01:32] Elliot (Redwood): Makes sense. We can do continuous batching and caching, plus model choices.

[05:10] Alina: Were on Together right now. Their tail latency spikes.
[05:18] Jordan: Yeah, we hear that. Dedicated can help if youre hitting noisy neighbor issues.

[10:40] Sam: Rate limits?
[10:44] Elliot: We can set per-route limits and burst.

[18:05] Alina: How hard is migration from OpenAI-style API?
[18:10] Jordan: We have OpenAI compatible endpoints and examples.

[27:30] Jordan: Ill send pricing ranges and an SDK example for streaming + function calling.
